name: Pervy Data Center Chelyabinsk
notes: Local commercial data center/hosting provider in Chelyabinsk at Truda 24; offers server rental and colocation. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Rostelecom Chelyabinsk regional data center site
notes: DCD reported Rostelecom owned regional data center sites including Chelyabinsk as part of its geographically diversified network; local Rostelecom page markets data-center technical resources. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Key Point Far East regional data center network - Chukotka option
developer: Key Point Group / Corporation for Development of the Far East and Arctic
notes: WEF-2022 agreement covered study of analogous Key Point regional data centers, including Chukotka, as part of a future Far East segment. No site, schedule, or capacity disclosed.

name: Republican Data Processing Center, Cheboksary
notes: Open tender announced for a modern republican data processing center in container or modular form in Cheboksary; initial maximum contract price 285.2 million rubles. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Key Point Dagestan Data Center
notes: Official Key Point page lists the Dagestan facility as under construction, 440 IT racks, 3 MW IT load, Tier III target, address in Khasavyurt district, planned launch in 2027.

name: Republic of Ingushetia data center / digital infrastructure project
notes: Regional economic-potential materials cite IT park/technopark development and construction of a data processing center/data center as a proposed digital-sector direction; no firm site, capacity, or award found.

name: Cloud X CX Data Center-1, Ust-Ilimsk district
developer: Cloud X / Cloud Solutions / En+ Group
notes: Kommersant reported Cloud X confirmed preparation to build a hyperscale AI/cloud data center in Zheleznodorozhny, Ust-Ilimsk district; 2,880 racks, 72 MW compute load, 154 MW planned consumption, first of three planned 154 MW sites near Ust-Ilimsk HPP, completion target 2027. Official Cloud X page title/search result indicates a construction permit for COD-1.

name: Key Point Irkutsk Data Center
notes: Official Key Point page lists Irkutsk facility in development with 220 IT racks, 1.8 MW IT capacity, Tier III target, planned launch in 2028.

name: Bit+ modular cryptocurrency mining data center near Bratsk
notes: En+ announced first phase operational with 10 MW committed and plan to scale to about 40 MW; facility near BitRiver's Bratsk data center in Irkutsk Region, using modular mining units.

name: BitRiver Bratsk data center
notes: Reuters/iTnews described BitRiver's flagship Siberian data center near the Angara River/Bratsk as 100 MW and planning to double output; En+ confirms BitRiver operates the largest Russia/CIS bitcoin-mining colocation data center in Bratsk/Irkutsk region.

name: BitCluster Irkutsk mining facility
notes: Baxtel lists a BitCluster mining facility in Irkutsk with ASIC hosting terms; BitCluster official page confirms a network of mining data centers but does not expose detailed site capacity.

name: BitCluster Ivanovo mining center
notes: Baxtel reports BitCluster operates mining centers in Saransk and Ivanovo collectively hosting more than 2,870 ASIC miners in 20 containers; capacity split for Ivanovo not disclosed.

name: Key Point Far East regional data center network - Kamchatka option
developer: Key Point Group / Corporation for Development of the Far East and Arctic
notes: WEF-2022 agreement covered study of analogous Key Point regional data centers, including Kamchatka, as part of a future Far East segment. No site, schedule, or capacity disclosed.

name: Ministry of Health and Resorts of Kabardino-Balkaria data center
developer: Softline for Ministry of Health and Resorts of Kabardino-Balkaria
notes: Softline completed a ministry data center consolidating departmental data and supporting email, videoconferencing, and medical information systems; capacity not disclosed.
